records.context: Three conventions apply.  image data channel numbers are zero-based and diameters are pixels, so values copied from one magnification are not portable without conversion.  The default v1 mask workflow preserves the directory layout expected by downstream tools; ``pipeline_style='v2'`` is opt-in and writes a different streaming layout.  Finally, removing UMAP cluster noise also removes those objects from the returned frame, keeping the table and the visible embedding aligned rather than silently returning different samples.
records.label: spacr.core#11
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: Three conventions apply.  Channel numbers are zero-based and diameters are pixels, so values copied from one magnification are not portable without conversion.  The default v1 mask pipeline preserves the directory layout expected by downstream tools; ``pipeline_style='v2'`` is opt-in and writes a different streaming layout.  Finally, removing UMAP cluster noise also removes those objects from the returned frame, keeping the table and the visible embedding aligned rather than silently returning different samples.
records.translation: 有三条约定。通道编号从零开始，直径以像素为单位，因此从一种放大倍数复制的值不经换算就不能直接沿用。默认的 v1 掩膜流程保留下游工具所需的目录结构；``pipeline_style='v2'`` 需主动启用，并写出另一种流式目录结构。最后，移除 UMAP 聚类噪声时也会从返回的数据框中移除这些对象，使表格与可见的嵌入保持一致，而不是悄悄返回不同的样本。

records.context: This landing page currently serves two spaCR tiles.  **Mask** runs :func:`preprocess_generate_masks` to turn raw multichannel acquisitions into preprocessed arrays and Cellpose masks for cells, nuclei, pathogens, and organelles.  **Image UMAP** runs :func:`generate_image_umap` to reduce measured single-object features, cluster them, and optionally place representative extracted image regions on the embedding.  The same module also exposes the timelapse-mask entry point; the two main workflows remain independent, and UMAP does not segment images.
records.label: spacr.core#2
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: This landing page currently serves two spaCR tiles.  **Mask** runs :func:`preprocess_generate_masks` to turn raw multichannel acquisitions into preprocessed arrays and Cellpose masks for cells, nuclei, pathogens, and organelles.  **Image UMAP** runs :func:`generate_image_umap` to reduce measured single-object features, cluster them, and optionally place representative image crops on the embedding.  The same module also exposes the timelapse-mask entry point; the two main workflows remain independent, and UMAP does not segment images.
records.translation: 此入口页面目前对应两个 spaCR 图块。**Mask** 运行 :func:`preprocess_generate_masks`，将原始多通道采集数据转换为预处理数组以及细胞、细胞核、病原体和细胞器的 Cellpose 掩膜。**Image UMAP** 运行 :func:`generate_image_umap`，对测得的单对象特征进行降维和聚类，并可选择在嵌入图上放置有代表性的图像裁剪。同一模块还提供时间序列掩膜的入口；两个主要工作流程相互独立，UMAP 不会分割图像。

records.source: Reads measurements from the SQLite backend(s), applies preprocessing and dimensionality reduction, clusters the embedding, and renders scatter/grid plots of the resulting clusters.
records.translation: 从 SQLite 后端读取测量值，进行预处理和降维，对嵌入进行聚类，并绘制所得聚类的散点图/网格图。

records.context: The thumbnails overlaid on the embedding come from whichever extracted-image-region source ``crop_source`` names: ``'png'`` (and ``'auto'`` wherever an extracted image region folder exists) reads the pre-generated PNGs, ``'merged'`` (and ``'auto'`` with no folder) cuts each one out of ``merged/*.npy`` on demand through :mod:`spacr.crops`, so the embedding can be drawn on a project that never kept an extracted image region folder — ``png_list`` is not required in that case. Either way the pixels arrive through :mod:`spacr.crops`, so a legacy (pre-341f446) extracted-image-region folder is image data channel-corrected on load and the montage shows the same image the Annotate application view does.
records.label: spacr.core.generate_image_umap#2
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: The thumbnails overlaid on the embedding come from whichever crop source ``crop_source`` names: ``'png'`` (and ``'auto'`` wherever a crop folder exists) reads the pre-generated PNGs, ``'merged'`` (and ``'auto'`` with no folder) cuts each one out of ``merged/*.npy`` on demand through :mod:`spacr.crops`, so the embedding can be drawn on a project that never kept a crop folder — ``png_list`` is not required in that case. Either way the pixels arrive through :mod:`spacr.crops`, so a legacy (pre-341f446) crop folder is channel-corrected on load and the montage shows the same image the Annotate screen does.
records.translation: 叠加在嵌入上的缩略图来自 ``crop_source`` 指定的裁剪来源：``'png'``（以及存在裁剪文件夹时的 ``'auto'``）读取预先生成的 PNG，``'merged'``（以及没有该文件夹时的 ``'auto'``）则按需从 ``merged/*.npy`` 中经由 :mod:`spacr.crops` 裁剪出每一张，因此即使项目从未保留裁剪文件夹，也能绘制嵌入 —— 此时不需要 ``png_list``。无论哪种方式，像素都经由 :mod:`spacr.crops` 获得，因此旧版（pre-341f446）裁剪文件夹在加载时会进行通道校正，拼图显示的图像与 Annotate 界面显示的相同。

records.context: The returned DataFrame always contains the columns ``path`` and ``pred``. A single-logit head is converted with ``torch.sigmoid``, so ``pred`` is the positive-class probability; a multi-logit head is converted with ``torch.softmax``, so ``pred`` is the probability of class 1 for two classes and the winning class's confidence for more. With more than two classes the frame also carries ``predicted_label`` and one ``prob_class_<i>`` column per class. Results are also written to a CSV file derived from ``model_path`` and the current date.
records.label: spacr.deep_spacr.apply_model#18

records.source: The returned DataFrame always contains the columns ``path`` and ``pred``. A single-logit head is converted with ``torch.sigmoid``, so ``pred`` is the positive-class probability; a multi-logit head is converted with ``torch.softmax``, so ``pred`` is the probability of class 1 for two classes and the winning class's confidence for more. With more than two classes the frame also carries ``predicted_label`` and one ``prob_class_<i>`` column per class. Results are also written to a CSV file derived from ``model_path`` and the current date.
records.translation: 返回的 DataFrame 始终包含 ``path`` 和 ``pred`` 列。单 logit 输出头用 ``torch.sigmoid`` 转换，因此 ``pred`` 是正类的概率；多 logit 输出头用 ``torch.softmax`` 转换，因此两个类别时 ``pred`` 是类别 1 的概率，更多类别时则是胜出类别的置信度。类别数多于两个时，数据框还带有 ``predicted_label`` 以及每个类别一列 ``prob_class_<i>``。结果还会写入一个 CSV 文件，其文件名由 ``model_path`` 和当前日期生成。

records.context: Thin wrapper over :func:`spacr.predictions.merge_cv_predictions`, the merge path Classify (CV) and Classify (ML) share. records.source: Thin wrapper over :func:`spacr.predictions.merge_cv_predictions`, the merge path Classify (CV) and Classify (ML) share. The join key is chosen from ``prcfo``, ``png_path`` and ``file_name``, whichever matches the most rows, with ties going to ``prcfo``; a computed basename is not used. A key that arrives with two different values is written nowhere and counted, rows that cannot be placed are counted, and the merge runs in one transaction. See :mod:`spacr.predictions`.
records.translation: 对 :func:`spacr.predictions.merge_cv_predictions` 的轻量封装，Classify (CV) 和 Classify (ML) 共用这一合并路径。连接键从 ``prcfo``、``png_path`` 和 ``file_name`` 中选择匹配行数最多的一个，数量相同时选 ``prcfo``；不使用计算得到的文件基本名。带有两个不同值的键不会写入任何位置，而是计入统计；无法定位的行也会计入统计，整个合并在一个事务中执行。参见 :mod:`spacr.predictions`。

records.translation: 四元组 ``(metrics, probs, labels, results_df)``。``metrics`` 是汇总字典，其中添加了 ``loss``、``epoch`` 和 ``Accuracy``。``probs`` 在单 logit 输出头时形状为 ``(N,)``，否则为 ``(N, C)``。``labels`` 是真实类别 ID 列表。``results_df`` 每张图像一行，包含 ``filename``、``true_label``、``predicted_label``，以及 ``class_1_probability``（单 logit 输出头）或每个类别一列 ``prob_class_<k>``。``predicted_label`` 对单 logit 输出头以 0.5 为阈值，而不是以指标所报告的 ``optimal_threshold`` 为阈值。

records.context: ``crop_source`` chooses where the pixels come from. ``'png'`` (and ``'auto'`` wherever an extracted image region folder exists) copies the pre-generated PNGs, unchanged. ``'merged'`` (and ``'auto'`` with no extracted-image-region folder) cuts each selected extracted image region out of ``merged/*.npy`` through :mod:`spacr.crops` instead: the labels still come from ``png_list``, but the pixels are cut fresh at the current extracted-image-region settings, so the training set costs no standing disk and cannot be built out of a folder that has gone stale. records.label: spacr.io.generate_training_dataset#7
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: ``crop_source`` chooses where the pixels come from. ``'png'`` (and ``'auto'`` wherever a crop folder exists) copies the pre-generated PNGs, unchanged. ``'merged'`` (and ``'auto'`` with no crop folder) cuts each selected crop out of ``merged/*.npy`` through :mod:`spacr.crops` instead: the labels still come from ``png_list``, but the pixels are cut fresh at the current crop settings, so the training set costs no standing disk and cannot be built out of a folder that has gone stale. A project with no ``png_list`` at all falls back to the object measurement table, which still carries everything the metadata rules select on.
records.translation: ``crop_source`` 决定像素的来源。``'png'``（以及存在裁剪文件夹时的 ``'auto'``）原样复制预先生成的 PNG。``'merged'``（以及没有裁剪文件夹时的 ``'auto'``）则改为从 ``merged/*.npy`` 中经由 :mod:`spacr.crops` 裁剪出每个选中的裁剪图：标签仍来自 ``png_list``，但像素按当前的裁剪设置重新裁剪，因此训练集不占用常驻磁盘空间，也不可能由已经过时的文件夹构建。完全没有 ``png_list`` 的项目会退回使用对象测量表，该表仍包含元数据规则进行选择所需的全部信息。

records.context: seed for the shuffle. Both branches use it: ungrouped, it shuffles each class and picks the starting fold; grouped, it orders groups of equal size and breaks ties between folds the greedy pass rates equally, so re-running with a different seed gives a different — and equally stratified — partition. Where only one partition is feasible (as many groups as folds, say) no seed can change it.
records.label: spacr.io.make_cv_folds#5
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: seed for the shuffle. Both branches use it: ungrouped, it shuffles each class and picks the starting fold; grouped, it orders groups of equal size and breaks ties between folds the greedy pass rates equally, so re-running with a different seed gives a different — and equally stratified — partition. Where only one partition is feasible (as many groups as folds, say) no seed can change it.
records.translation: 用于打乱的随机种子。两个分支都会使用它：不分组时，它打乱每个类别并选择起始折；分组时，它对大小相同的组排序，并在贪心步骤评分相同的折之间打破平局，因此用不同的种子重新运行会得到一个不同的 —— 且同样分层的 —— 划分。当只有一种可行划分时（例如组数与折数相同），任何种子都无法改变它。

records.context: Target share of samples to hold out, strictly between 0 and 1; any number outside that range, ``nan`` and ``inf`` included, is a ``ValueError``. It is only a target. The holdout is one whole fold of a split into ``max(2, round(1 / fraction))`` folds, itself capped at the number of distinct groups, so the realised share is quantised to whole groups and can miss in either direction, by a lot. Over eight equal groups, 0.05 holds out 0.125 (no finer split is available) and 0.7 holds out 0.5 (the two-fold floor); with one dominant group — 70 of 100 samples across four groups — those same two requests instead hold out 0.10 and 0.70. Whenever the realised share is further than ``max(0.01, 0.1 * validation_fraction)`` from the requested one, a ``UserWarning`` names both numbers and why they differ.
records.label: spacr.io.make_validation_holdout#3
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: Target share of samples to hold out, strictly between 0 and 1; any number outside that range, ``nan`` and ``inf`` included, is a ``ValueError``. It is only a target. The holdout is one whole fold of a split into ``max(2, round(1 / fraction))`` folds, itself capped at the number of distinct groups, so the realised share is quantised to whole groups and can miss in either direction, by a lot. Over eight equal groups, 0.05 holds out 0.125 (no finer split is available) and 0.7 holds out 0.5 (the two-fold floor); with one dominant group — 70 of 100 samples across four groups — those same two requests instead hold out 0.10 and 0.70. Whenever the realised share is further than ``max(0.01, 0.1 * validation_fraction)`` from the requested one, a ``UserWarning`` names both numbers and why they differ.
records.translation: 要留出的样本目标比例，必须严格介于 0 和 1 之间；超出该范围的任何数值，包括 ``nan`` 和 ``inf``，都会引发 ``ValueError``。这只是一个目标值。留出集是划分为 ``max(2, round(1 / fraction))`` 个折时的一个完整折，折数本身不超过不同组的数量，因此实际比例按整组量化，可能在任一方向上偏离很多。在八个大小相同的组上，0.05 实际留出 0.125（没有更细的划分可用），0.7 实际留出 0.5（两折下限）；而当存在一个占主导的组时 —— 四个组共 100 个样本，其中 70 个在同一组 —— 同样的两个请求则分别留出 0.10 和 0.70。只要实际比例与请求比例相差超过 ``max(0.01, 0.1 * validation_fraction)``，就会发出 ``UserWarning``，给出这两个数值及其差异原因。

records.context: The enhancement chain follows the same route. Make Masks' chain (:mod:`spacr.qt.detect_chain`) is written into a settings file as the ``enhance_*`` structured-data names and read back here by :func:`prepare_chain`, with the ``psf_*`` settings folded in as the chain's PSF stage, so one plate run applies exactly the steps a curator tuned, in the chain's own order: background, PSF, denoise, contrast, sharpen. The session applies it per selected channel at the stage the PSF already ran -- after illumination correction and before normalization -- and its provenance goes into the same ``psf/segmentation_application.json`` record, so a changed chain is refused on resume the way a changed kernel is. With no chain step on, a processing session is byte for byte what it was before the chain existed.
records.label: spacr.psf_pipeline#2
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: The enhancement chain follows the same route. Make Masks' chain (:mod:`spacr.qt.detect_chain`) is written into a settings file as the ``enhance_*`` keys and read back here by :func:`prepare_chain`, with the ``psf_*`` settings folded in as the chain's PSF stage, so one plate run applies exactly the steps a curator tuned, in the chain's own order: background, PSF, denoise, contrast, sharpen. The session applies it per selected channel at the stage the PSF already ran -- after illumination correction and before normalization -- and its provenance goes into the same ``psf/segmentation_application.json`` record, so a changed chain is refused on resume the way a changed kernel is. With no chain step on, a run is byte for byte what it was before the chain existed.
records.translation: 增强链遵循相同的路径。Make Masks 的增强链（:mod:`spacr.qt.detect_chain`）以 ``enhance_*`` 键写入设置文件，并在这里由 :func:`prepare_chain` 读回，同时将 ``psf_*`` 设置并入作为链中的 PSF 阶段，因此一次整板运行会严格按照链自身的顺序应用整理者调好的步骤：背景、PSF、去噪、对比度、锐化。会话在 PSF 原本运行的阶段 -- 光照校正之后、归一化之前 -- 对每个所选通道应用该链，其来源记录写入同一个 ``psf/segmentation_application.json`` 记录，因此续跑时会拒绝已更改的链，就像拒绝已更改的卷积核一样。未启用任何链步骤时，运行结果与引入增强链之前逐字节相同。

records.translation: 对于噬斑，在解读数量或面积之前先检查掩膜。对于募集，在比较处理条件之前先核实对象过滤器、实验条件标注和每孔分母。对于入侵，在使用效率表之前先检查视野级阈值、对照一致性、双峰性和敏感性标记。对于复制，在比较倍增分布之前先检查液泡分组和报告的非 2 的幂比例。在这四个图块获得各自独立的 API 页面之前，请参阅上面列出的具体函数链接。

records.context: The analysis unit matters.  Invasion is inferred from *absence* of outside stain, so weak staining can only inflate the invaded fraction; thresholds are therefore recorded per field and statistics use microplate sample positions rather than treating parasites from one microplate sample position as independent replicates.  Replication groups by vacuole, not by host cell, because one cell can contain several vacuoles; 3, 5, 6, and 7 parasites remain in an explicit non-power-of-two QC bucket instead of being rounded into a biologically expected class.  Plaque area is calibrated against the microplate sample position scale when available, so comparisons should retain the acquisition metadata that defines that scale.
records.label: spacr.submodules#9
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: The analysis unit matters.  Invasion is inferred from *absence* of outside stain, so weak staining can only inflate the invaded fraction; thresholds are therefore recorded per field and statistics use wells rather than treating parasites from one well as independent replicates.  Replication groups by vacuole, not by host cell, because one cell can contain several vacuoles; 3, 5, 6, and 7 parasites remain in an explicit non-power-of-two QC bucket instead of being rounded into a biologically expected class.  Plaque area is calibrated against the well scale when available, so comparisons should retain the acquisition metadata that defines that scale.
records.translation: 分析单位很重要。入侵是根据外部染色的*缺失*推断的，因此弱染色只会抬高已入侵比例；为此，阈值按视野记录，统计以孔为单位，而不是把同一孔中的寄生虫当作独立的重复。复制按液泡而非宿主细胞分组，因为一个细胞可以包含多个液泡；3、5、6 和 7 个寄生虫会保留在一个明确的非 2 的幂 QC 类别中，而不会被四舍五入到生物学上预期的类别。噬斑面积在可用时根据孔的尺度进行校准，因此进行比较时应保留定义该尺度的采集元数据。

records.source: This is a separate pass rather than a branch inside the segmenter because the two shapes of input differ in what a result row means. One field per image gives one row per image; a plate gives one row per well, and the well has to be named or the conditions are pooled into a single meaningless count. Splitting first makes every downstream row a well, whichever shape arrived.
records.translation: 这是一个独立的处理步骤，而不是分割器内部的一个分支，因为两种输入形式中结果行的含义不同。每张图像一个视野时，每张图像对应一行；整块板时，每个孔对应一行，而且孔必须有名称，否则各实验条件会被合并成一个毫无意义的计数。先进行拆分，可以让下游的每一行都对应一个孔，无论输入是哪种形式。
